newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Trans-Philippines ups stake in AGPI.
newsitem.headline: Trans-Philippines ups stake in AGPI.

text.p: Trans-Philippines Investment Corp (TPIC) is increasing its stake in AGP Industrial Corp (AGPI) by converting its debt into equity, AGPI corporate secretary Roberto Laurel said on Monday.
TPIC currently holds a majority stake in AGPI.
AGPI has outstanding debt of about 156 million pesos owed to its parent TPIC which would be converted into equity.
The AGPI would issue 1.5 million class A shares and 500,000 class B shares to cover for the debt-for-equity swap with TPIC.
AGPI officials were unavailable to give details on how much the debt-for-equity programme will boost TPIC stake in AGPI.
The conversion price has been set at 39 pesos per share, Laurel told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
The exercise will raise its capital stock to 132 million pesos from 120 million.
Both AGPI A and B shares closed at 26.50 pesos last Thursday.
